item.title: The Isuzu D-Max has been updated to suit your lifestyle
item.description: In 2003, Isuzu Philippines debuted the D-Max in a market that—for decades—had lived with the trusty Fuego . Ever since, it has been a hit seller in the pickup truck segment and has consistently been at the forefront of Japanese-brand sales, thanks to its dependable quality and reliability.
